source.check: the two Ballycultra nominations (Mr. John H. B. Murphy, Cultra Lodge; Mr. George Dobler, Craigdarragh Road) read on the page image of the Northern Whig of 14 May 1927, p. 5; Murphy's withdrawal ('there will be no contest') read on the page image of the Northern Whig of 12 May 1927, p. 8

note: Triennial election of the Castlereagh rural district councillors. A contest was threatened in Ballycultra, but Mr. J. H. Murphy withdrew, so all nine divisions were returned unopposed and there was no poll. Filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page images of the Northern Whig, 14 May 1927, p. 5 and 12 May 1927, p. 8 (w19-bna-fix2, Nov 2026): Ballycultra had two nominations, Mr. John H. B. Murphy and Mr. George Dobler; Murphy withdrew, so the member returned unopposed was George Dobler (the sitting member for Ballycultra in 1930), not Murphy, who had been recorded in error.
